fields.description: Numbered by its position in the table.
fields.label: Flush Number

fields.description: Planting to this harvest. Typed here because it is what every crop has: not all of them are pinched.
fields.label: Weeks from planting to harvesting

fields.description: This flush's share of everything the plant gives. Worked out from the stems if they are stated; typed instead when the shape of the harvest is known before the stems are.
fields.label: % of life

fields.description: Everything gathered by the end of this flush. The last row is 100%: the plant may carry on, but planning stops where the yield it was planned for is in.
fields.label: Cumulative %

fields.description: Worked out: weeks from planting, less the weeks to pinching. Meaningless on a crop that is never pinched, where it is simply the same as weeks from planting.
fields.label: Weeks from pinch

fields.description: Week of year this flush lands on, relative to the planting week
fields.label: Harvest Week (rel.)
